say:2:1620731001:1.text: Are you alright, Bridger?! I just saw that magic carpet turn into a flying Hypofiend.
say:2:1620731001:1.source_cn: 布里奇特，你没事吧！我刚刚看到你脚下的魔法飞毯变成了巨...

say:3:1620731002:1.text: Pippa! Magister Merlin! Perfect timing. I was just practicing the chaos magic you created, Pippa. Poofy took me flying. It was so fast and smooth.
say:3:1620731002:1.source_cn: 是皮帕和梅林大人！真巧，我刚才正在练习皮帕你发明的混沌...
say:3:1620731002:1.male: Pippa! Magister Merlin! Perfect timing. I was just practicing the chaos magic you created, Pippa. Poofy took me flying. It was so fast and smooth.
say:3:1620731002:1.female: Pippa! Magister Merlin! Perfect timing. I was just practicing the chaos magic you created, Pippa. Poofy took me flying. It was so fast and smooth.

say:4:1620731003:1.text: Too bad it changed back as soon as we got here. Guess the magic wore off. I really wanted you to see it for yourself.
say:4:1620731003:1.source_cn: 可惜它载着我到了这里之后就又变回魔法飞毯了，像是魔法时...
say:4:1620731003:1.male: Too bad it changed back as soon as we got here. Guess the magic wore off. I really wanted you to see it for yourself.
say:4:1620731003:1.female: Too bad it changed back as soon as we got here. Guess the magic wore off. I really wanted you to see it for yourself.

say:6:1620731005:1.text: Hahaha, that's the name I gave to the flying Hypofiend!
say:6:1620731005:1.source_cn: 哈哈，是我给那只飞行魔物起的新名字！

say:7:1620731006:1.text: It's well-behaved, loyal, and looks absolutely awesome! It's basically the kind of mount every hero has in those adventure stories!
say:7:1620731006:1.source_cn: 既乖巧温顺，又忠心耿耿，还长得这么威风……它简直就像那...

say:9:1620731008:1.text: Shh! I think I spotted something. Let's move quietly and check it out.
say:9:1620731008:1.source_cn: 嘘——我有发现！我们动作放轻点，去那边看看。
